scenario: A federal student-loan servicer processes a borrower's economic-hardship deferment request. The borrower submits supporting documentation (pay stubs or unemployment award letter). The pipeline extracts the borrower's income and household data, checks eligibility against the statutory 150% federal poverty guideline threshold (34 CFR §685.204/§685.205), and produces a formal deferment determination letter (Grant or Deny).
info_flow: csv-pipeline parses the borrower income/household CSV extracted from supporting documents → presale-regulation-auditor audits the eligibility rules and emits policy parameters (income ceiling, multiplier) → financial-calculator applies the parameters to compute gross_income_ratio and produces the determination letter.
